title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E05 — Smoke Signals and Fire Fights
Spotting smoke on a distant shore, a team pushes to find another camp; the jungle trek has Mandy at her breaking point; Dani and Jarrell's clashing survival styles spark a blowout fight; a survivalist is medically evacuated from the challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E06 — Spewing and Stinging Venom
Dani and Jarrell's heated fight splinters their camp, forcing Jamie to pick sides; a hunt leads to a food win in another camp; as teams merge, dynamics begin to shift; a stingray attack puts a survivalist at risk.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E07 — The Lost Coast's Revenge
Jamie battles searing pain and a deadly infection after the stingray attack. Malu and Mandy struggle with Ana Lis' survival priorities.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E11 — Father's Day Fury
As spring tornado season rolls into Father's Day weekend, a rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E01 — Tornado Torrent 2025
In March 2025, thousands of eyewitnesses capture disaster at their doorsteps as extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 150 tornadoes across the southern states, devastating towns and homesteads in their path.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E01 — Welcome to Hellfire
When Jerry Jr. learns that legendary chef Guy Fieri has bought a used Apocalypse Hellfire truck at an auction, he offers Guy free customization; Frank locks in a deal to build a custom Overland truck for internet superstar Nick The Wrangler Bishop.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E09 — Tickle's Restaurant
On the midseason premiere, Tickle and Carol open their new restaurant while Tickle contends with conflicting priorities; Mark and Digger enlist Amanda to improve their wildly popular hazelnut rum; Josh shocks his outlaw partners.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E04 — Tricks, Treats, and Tows
A drunk man dressed like a giant baby refuses to let Shawn tow his car; a frightening find spooks Pineapple; during a call at a haunted house, the tow truck driver is terrified.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E07 — Bachelorette Brawl
The ladies of Vegas give the tow truck drivers a run for their money when Pineapple fends off a bevy of bachelorettes in a bus; Kyle encounters a showgirl; Shawn faces off with Goliath and scores are settled between the tow companies.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E05 — Heartbreak Hotel
The crazies on the Strip keep the tow bros busy; TW goes toe-to-toe with an angry Elvis, and Jeremy contends with salty strip club clients while Pineapple senses déjà vu in a trucker's lot; Elmer is sent on a fool's errand.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E03 — Shawn Comes Up Snake Eyes
At a call on the Strip, Shawn is shocked by a six-foot python in a car's front seat; TW tangles with a motel customer twice his size; Elmer races to rescue a fellow driver in danger; a driver's window is smashed.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E06 — Vegas Hall Pass
Pineapple argues with a woman who has a hall pass from her husband; Jeremy gets in a fight, and Elmer hunts for a massive haul; TW's easy tow turns into an ordeal, while a crazy customer goes ballistic on Bridgett; Shawn makes a spooky discovery.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E02 — The Rat Pack
When a drug dog alerts a vehicle full of clubbers heading to a techno bar, officers find the group has gotten creative with their illicit drugs; officers inspecting a couple's truck find bags full of rat carcasses to be used in a specialty soup.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E01 — Seedy Behavior
When an older couple crossing into the US has cartel logos on their packed clothes, they have some explaining to do; a Mexican driver says he's visiting a friend in Texas, but seems nervous; a vehicle search finds evidence of hidden compartments.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E06 — Joint Failure
When a trailer full of sea salt shows up at the bridge, officers decide to inspect it; the bags do contain a crystalline substance, and it's an illicit one; during an inspection of a U.S. citizen, something illegal rolls out of his pocket.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E03 — Trifecta of Trouble
A speaker cabinet is found to be carrying more than just sweet beats; a driver who took a wrong turn and ended up at the border crossing is packing more than he should be; following a recent smuggling trend, officers carry out a special operation.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E01 — The Flint-Stoners
Officers examine a trailer filled with cooking supplies and unearth a GPS tracker, the kind cartels use to watch their loads; US citizens who accidentally approach the international border are inspected, and it turns out they have a few secrets.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E02 — I Don't Practice Santeria
With cartels using drones, a newly formed CBP drone strike unit is taking aim at cartel eyes in the sky; an officer suspects that a vehicle may be carrying more than some innocent Santeria sprays.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E06 — Bristol County Jail
In Bristol County Jail, half of the cells don't lock; as changing demographics bring in more violent, gang-affiliated criminals, staff must manage a higher-risk population without the facility slipping into chaos.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E03 — Clayton County, Georgia
Behind the walls of Clayton County Jail, deteriorating infrastructure creates dangerous conditions for both inmates and staff.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E11 — Rookies for the Win
While some officers have years of experience, others are stepping up for the first time — fresh out of training, and ready to prove themselves. Because at the border, a rookie's first day could be a smuggler's last chance.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E09 — Indian River County Jail
On Florida's Treasure Coast, home to some of the priciest real estate in the state, Indian River County Jail serves the people who wealth left behind. Deputies invest in programs, mentorship and second chances to keep them from coming back.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E10 — Super-load Sunday
Officers are caught off guard when a high-end sports car arrives at the border packing heat. At the bus terminal, a K9 alerts to a traveler's luggage. Upon investigation, officers find photographs showing large amounts of cash on her phone.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E01 — Tramadol to Hell
A driver claims he buys used cars over the border to import into the U.S., but an X-ray reveals something hidden in his spare tire; when a traveler returning from Mexico declares snacks at customs, a fish and wildlife expert is called in.

title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only
description:
S02 E13 — Take a Swing at Swanstrom
Farmtruck and AZN gather another group of local racers in North Carolina and one favorite rises above the rest; the last local standing gets a chance to race against Justin Swanstrom, who's as fast as he is fiery and won't give much up.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E10 — Boldest Bootleg
Under cover of Tickle's new restaurant and Josh's new business, the Virginia boys attempt a 500-gallon bootleg; when the creek runs dry, Jerry designs what he hopes will be a revolutionary waterless still; Tim and Howard make rum from corn stalks.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E06 — Goldshiner
When Josh finally completes his decade-long bunker project, he fires up the still for a first-ever run of gold flake cinnamon shine; Mark and Digger deliver some backwoods justice to an unscrupulous man selling industrial alcohol as pot still liquor.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E07 — A New Tariff in Town
After rivals destroy Tim's Canada-bound moonshine, he relocates his tariff-dodging operation to Kentucky, where neighbors follow their own unwritten code.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E08 — Kentucky Kingpin
Tim goes full outlaw in the Bluegrass State only to uncover the dark side of working with a Kentucky shine boss.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E09 — Run for the Border
Tim and Howard race to complete a thousand-gallon order before the Canadian tariff-running boat docks; Josh takes cover as surveyors set stakes above his underground still site; Mike and Jerry tail their bootlegger and uncover a back road speakeasy.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E02 — The Kilted Keisterer?
Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker. A judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E04 — Tornado Alley Weed Farm
Six teams of chasers brave Oklahoma back roads as a late spring warm front unleashes long-track tornadoes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E03 — Danger Close in Dakota
Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E05 — Spin City
While chasing a monster in Alabama, Sarah parts ways with Reed moments before he takes the Dominator for a spin inside a tornado.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E06 — Tornado of the Year
Every year tornado junkies descend on America's tornado alley; these storm chasers put everything on the line to prove they're the best in the game.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E07 — Matt's National Treasure Hunt
Matt chases a rare copy of the Declaration of Independence in a hoard; he digs through a 4,000-square-foot chicken coop for vintage motorcycles; a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine could be a big find if they can get it out of the chicken coop.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E04 — Barnstorming for Dollars
The team pulls 50,000 pounds of trash from a hoarder's Tennessee farmhouse. A safe could hold a generational jewelry collection.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E03 — Matt's Michigan Magic
A widower's home is so dangerously packed and impassable that his family will no longer visit.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E13 — From Rats to Riches
Matt's team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already; the team also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E01 — Betting Big on Little Balls
In a modern-day treasure hunt, Matt Paxton, the "King of Hoards," gambles that he can clean out dangerously cluttered homes and find hidden riches; Matt and his team search for a vintage Mustang, military artifacts, and a $60,000 marble collection.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E07 — On a Mission for G.I. Dough
Matt and his troops head to the Pacific Northwest to search a three-barn hoard loaded with U.S. military treasures, including Willy's Jeeps and uniforms; a biohazard mess hides first-generation computers and video equipment at a second location.

Josh Owens, Mark Rogers and up-and-comer Daniel Maner compete to see who makes Appalachia's most authentic backwoods shine and win a rare jar of Popcorn Sutton's liquor.

Mark and Digger challenge Amanda to distill brandy and grappa from the same grapes; the Maggie Valley trio scours the scrapyards for a stolen copper still.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E03 — Terror of the Bell Witch
Josh dives into one of the country's oldest witch stories; in the Tennessee backwoods, locals report being attacked in a vast cave system; Jess and Phil go underground and uncover frightening piles of bones as well as possible human remains.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E02 — Round-Up at Death Ranch
Bizarre cattle mutations in the Pacific Northwest lead Josh Gates to send his team to investigate; the baffling deaths make Jessica and Phil question whether the cattle are victims of newly arrived apex predators or something more sinister.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
The Van Meter Monster
Horrified locals in southern Iowa are reporting sightings of a giant winged creature, the same mysterious beast that terrorized the town of Van Meter 100 years ago; Phil and Jess are on a mission to unearth clues to what's lurking in the shadows.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Terror in Appalachia
Hikers are going missing amid reports of grotesque, human-like creatures prowling Appalachia's Great Smoky Mountains; Phil and Jess venture into the unforgiving wilderness to investigate the truth behind terrifying sightings of feral people.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E05 — Lost Bomber of World War II
Weeks before the D-Day invasion, Britain's Barracuda bomber took out the largest Nazi warship ever built, but today, not a single Barracuda exists; Josh joins a one-of-a-kind restoration project and searches for wreckage far above the Arctic Circle.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E05 — Great Lakes' Vanished Warships
Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers; on their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E04 — America's First Train Robbers
Josh tracks down the legend and treasure of an outlaw posse, who terrorized the Midwest's railroads; Josh tracks the Reno Gang's lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E03 — Traitors' Treasure of 1776
Josh chases the fortune stolen by loyalists to Britain's crown during the American Revolution; investigations of the infamous Doan Gang; Josh helps dig up a cache of plundered coins; a cave search pinpoints the turncoats' hideout.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E05 — The Real Goonies Treasure
Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie; on the rocky shores of the Pacific, he finds pieces of a Spanish galleon that wrecked in 1694.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E06 — Vanderbilt's Lost Steamship
Josh braves Nicaragua's croc-infested waters and snake-filled jungle to find the wreckage of the Orus; chasing Gold Rush-era fortune, Vanderbilt's ship crashed in rapids on its maiden attempt to create a new route between the Atlantic and Pacific.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E05 — Spirits of 1776
As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike. A customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

S01 E04 — They Might Be Giants

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E12 — Carolina Crash Course
Mark and Digger invent a patriotic corn whiskey recipe using red, white and blue corn; Jerry's stolen still threatens to drive a wedge between partners; Josh returns to the safety of his home, only to crash his minivan into his own house.
